title: ACI 318, Section 21.
officialText:
10.2. Modify ACI 318, Section 21.10.2, to read as follows:
21.10.2 – Special structural walls constructed using precast concrete shall satisfy all the requirements of 21.9 for cast-in-place
special structural walls in addition to Sections 21.4.2 through 21.4.4.
